International Cheese Federation News and Advocacy Archive - February 2019
This page presents an archive of news and advocacy articles from the International Cheese Federation, specifically highlighting two posts from February 2019. Topics include the market disparity between commodity and artisan cheeses, and the challenges of cheese surplus, declining exports, and low farmgate milk prices, along with the federation's policy recommendations.

Industry News 

 

 

 



Yuri Lee 




 


Two markets, one cheese case 

 

Commodity cheese is drowning in surplus while our artisan members can’t make enough to fill orders. Both things are true at once, and the gap is where our members live.

Advocacy 

 

 

 



Yuri Lee 




 


The cheese nobody can move 

 

Cold-storage warehouses are holding more cheese than they ever have, exports are down, and farmgate milk prices are stuck. Here is what the federation is asking policymakers to do about it.
